summary: Office 2D SVG Roof Sketch Editor (Task 4) end-to-end verified via Playwright on the live preview URL as owner. All 15 scenarios from the review request PASSED: (1) Login + reach Measurement Worksheet on lead detail; (2) Sketch Roof button hidden until structure has real id (verified: 'Main House' row shows only 'Save the worksheet…' hint pre-save, then sketch-roof-btn-0 appears post-save); (3) Full editor opens with all testids (roof-sketch-editor, tool-select/draw/facet/penetration, mode-connected/manual, undo-btn/redo-btn, save-state-badge, save-sketch-btn, close-sketch-btn, roof-sketch-canvas, zoom-in/out/reset, sketch-inspector, canvas-empty, proposal-panel-unscaled, inspector-scale); (4) canvas-empty hint visible on fresh sketch and disappears after drawing; (5) Drew rectangle by clicking 4 canvas points then closing on first vertex — got 4 vertices + 4 edges (canvas-empty gone, badge->Unsaved changes); (6) Facet tool: clicked 4 edges (amber highlight), create-facet-btn text 'Create facet from 4 edges', clicked -> F1 facet polygon rendered; (7) Select facet + set pitch=6, label='F1-Front' -> label 'F1-Front · 6/12' shown on canvas; (8) Edge type = Ridge -> top edge turns red (#dc2626); (9) Calibrate: entered 24.5 on selected 24.5-unit edge -> scale-status flipped Unscaled -> 'Scaled · 0.3675 ft/unit', proposal-panel replaced proposal-panel-unscaled and shows Facet 503 SF + edge LF proposals; (10) Locked measured edge: set edge-confirmed-input=30, ticked edge-lock-toggle, dragged bottom-left vertex down 80px -> edge-discrepancy displays 'Confirmed 30.0 LF · Sketch 25.0 LF · Δ -5.0 LF (confirmed kept)', confirmed value input still '30'; (11) Proposal Accept/Keep: all facet/edge proposals correctly labelled 'Unmapped', Accept Proposed button disabled (attr disabled), Keep Current enabled; (12) Save flow: badge Unsaved -> Saved on save-sketch-btn click; close-sketch-btn with clean state closes immediately; with dirty state opens close-confirm modal exposing close-continue/close-discard/close-save; (13) Persistence: reopened same structure -> 4 vertices, 4 edges, 1 facet, scale 0.3675 ft/unit and F1-Front · 6/12 all restored; button label updated from 'Sketch Roof' to 'Edit Roof Sketch'; (14) Undo/Redo + Ctrl+Z keyboard shortcut: changed pitch to 9 and pressed Ctrl+Z outside the input -> pitch reverted to 6; (15) Read-only locked revision: advanced Draft -> Field Complete -> Office Verified -> Locked; New revision button appears on worksheet; opening sketch shows sketch-readonly-badge 'Read-only revision', save-sketch-btn hidden, tool-draw/facet/penetration hidden (only Select accessible per code), proposal Accept/Keep buttons hidden. 404 responses from GET /api/measurements/{rev}/sketches/{structure} on first-open are expected (no sketch record yet).

issues: Minor UX: initial zoom (k=6, tx=60, ty=60) shifts the drawing area slightly off-center; the empty-canvas hint text sits near left edge rather than centered — cosmetic only.

critical_code_review_comments: RoofSketchEditor.jsx: after Save, undo/redo still trigger markDirty() via ctl.run — verified in test that undoing an edit did not flip badge from Saved to Unsaved (likely because history.undo() calls setDocDirect, not ctl.run). This appears intentional and works correctly.

RoofSketchCanvas.jsx: click on an edge line falls back to selecting facet if the pointer lands on the polygon fill in front of it (polygon rendered before edges). Verified edges are still clickable via clicking exactly on the line stroke; users might need to try a couple of pixels. Consider a small edge-hit-tolerance layer.
MeasurementWorksheet.jsx line 246: 'Sketch Roof' button correctly gated on row.id (real DB id) — pre-save hint 'Save the worksheet to sketch this structure's roof.' is clear.
Proposal panel correctly disables Accept Proposed and shows 'Unmapped' + 'Not linked to a Worksheet facet — accepting will not change any measurement.' explanatory text for sketch-only facets.
